question.question: Does pruning the asymmetric low-rank real-atom triangle multiplicative pair update to mid-late layers 6, 8, and 10 only reduce late-horizon overfitting and improve matched 100K development MAE on the accepted BondLocal+PairNorm GPTrans-T parent?
question.deficiency: Five-layer real-atom triangle updates at layers 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 improved 100K development MAE by -1.667 meV at +19.4% wall overhead, but early gains faded in late training. Whether restricting triangle contraction to mid-late layers 6, 8, and 10 after local bond context matures prevents premature contraction overfitting and lowers wall overhead to ~1.116x is unmeasured.
alternatives: Early triangle contraction at layers 2 and 4 is helpful rather than premature
Mid-late 3-layer triangle contraction adds pair capacity without clearing the 3 meV gate
question.positive_decision: Nominate only for candidate-minus-reference selected EMA MAE <= -3.0 meV and paired 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 under strict acceptance; no automatic scale-up.
question.negative_decision: Close this mid-late 3-layer real-atom triangle pair intervention without hyperparameter grids or automatic retries.
